{"metadata":{"description":"Best ready-to-run DeepSeek Harness distribution: DSH desktop GUI, DSH terminal TUI, and harness integration.","id":"gh:1334020974","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"cocode","slug":"cocode-agency/cocode","topics":["agent","byok","cocode","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","desktop-app","dsh","dsh-plugin","free","tui","vibe-coding"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Best ready-to-run DeepSeek Harness distribution: DSH desktop GUI, DSH terminal TUI, and harness inte"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dy-to-run DeepSeek Harness distribution: DSH desktop GUI, DSH terminal TUI, and harness integration."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Cocode"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A ready-to-run DeepSeek Harness distribution.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Most coding agents make the choices for you and take the choice away with them:

makes the choices for you and leaves the screwdriver within reach:"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" the default
setup works the moment you install it, with nothing to study first, and when it
doesn't"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" fit you can open it up, see exactly how it was put together, and change
it to your liking. Everythi"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ng else in Cocode follows from that."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The runtime underneath is DeepSeek Harness, which makes an argument of its own:
everything is a plug"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"in. Models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, and

the assembly out in the open in the product instead of burying it in a config
file."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Project status:** Developer preview. Cocode is built on the DeepSeek Harness

| **TUI** | N"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ode.js `22.19.x` or later (`24+` is also supported), then `npm install --global @cocode-agency/tui`."},{"id":"p10s4","text":" | Run `cocode doctor`, then `cocode`. A real terminal is required. |
| **From source** | Follow the"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" component-specific pnpm instructions below. | Use `make dev gui` or `make dev tui`. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The published TUI package installs the matching `@cocode-agency/host-supervisor`

5. If startup fails, save the output of `cocode doctor` and
`cocode ho"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"st status --json` for troubleshooting. Remove credentials and
private session data before sharing di"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"--json` for troubleshooting. Remove credentials and
private session data before sharing diagnostics."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Why Cocode"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**The agent itself comes apart.** Which tools a session runs, what prompts it
carries, which capabil"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ities are on — that is a plugin assembly called a preset,
and you can read its `agent.cordis.yml` ri"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ght in the interface. Four presets
ship built in — Standard, PTC, Minimal, and Creator — and you cop"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"y one to make
it yours. Elsewhere you get to swap the model. Here you get to swap the agent."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**A workspace, not a chat box.** Files, Git, a terminal, a built-in browser, and
diff previews sit a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"longside the session. What the agent changed and what it ran
is right there next to you, and you can"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" take over by hand at any point instead
of carrying context between windows."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**The desktop and the terminal pick up the same session.** GUI and TUI connect
to the same Host and "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"read and write the same session record. Push a task forward
at your desk, then SSH in and continue f"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rom the terminal — presentation state
never enters the session log, so any client can rebuild the fu"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ll conversation
from it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**The model is your call too.** An official DeepSeek key, any OpenAI-compatible
self-hosted or gatew"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ay endpoint, or Cocode Pro's hosted Cocode Nut service — all
three are available, and you can switch"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"r Cocode Pro's hosted Cocode Nut service — all
three are available, and you can switch between them."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Cocode is not trying to be another chat window. It won't parade a full chain of
thought at you as a "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"feature, and it won't hand the model every tool by default.
What it wants to be is a workspace you t"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"rust with real work — and one you can
reshape to your own liking."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Two entry points, one session"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **Cocode GUI** | A desktop workspace built on Electron. Diffs and attachments open in a preview panel, so you see exactly what chan"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ged before you confirm. |
| **Cocode TUI** | A terminal client for keyboard-first and remote work. S"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"SH into a machine and keep pushing tasks with no graphical environment required. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Both attach to the same Host through `@cocode-agency/host-supervisor`, so they can share
sessions an"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"d task state when they use the same `DSH_HOME`, profile, and Host
configuration scope. Switching bet"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ween the desktop app and the terminal does
not reset your work within that scope."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Cocode GUI"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Cocode TUI"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Repository layout"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"This repository is not a single workspace. Each component is an independent
